beliefs: Only the final character of the string is shifted, and only if it is a letter [E1, E2, E3].
A final lowercase letter shifts forward by one, with 'z' wrapping to 'a' [E1, E2, E3].
A final uppercase letter shifts forward by one, with 'Z' wrapping to 'A' [E1, E2, E3].
All other characters (including non-final letters) pass through unchanged [E1, E2, E3].
Empty string maps to empty string [E1].
notes: Re-examined E3: the shift is not per-run but applies only to the string's last character when it's a letter. 'a1b'->'a1c' and 'a b'->'a c' confirm the leading 'a' is untouched; 'a'->'b' confirms a lone letter at the end shifts.
